event: Weekly Market Review
title: Weekly Market Review
text:
BOTTOM LINE — V-shaped recovery week; semis and silver led a violent squeeze.
The S&P posted its best week in 19 months (+5.60% to 7297.49), a dip-buying rebound in technology that lifted high-beta and cyclicals over defensives. Leadership was commodities-plus-AI, with silver and semis the tip of the spear while energy lagged badly. Note SOXX's 20d of -73.91% and ytd -57.26% look corrupt; flagging rather than leaning on them.

INDICES — QQQ +6.99%, IWM +6.69%, SPY +5.58%, DIA +5.51%.
Large beat small by just 0.30pp (large +6.99% vs small +6.69%) — a high-beta tape, not a mega-cap-only one. VIX sits at 26.8, still above its 23.6 20-day average; VIXY fell 7.77% Friday. Biggest cross-asset move: silver SLV +6.57% on the week, gold GLD +3.57%. Long bonds went the other way, TLT -1.18% Friday. SPY and QQQ remain below their 200-day MAs.

SECTORS & ROTATION —
XLB Materials +7.88%, XLK Technology +7.48%, XLC Comm Services +7.45%, XLY Cons Disc +6.68%, XLI Industrials +5.88%, XLF Financials +4.75%, XLRE Real Estate +3.96%, XLV Health Care +3.93%, XLP Staples +2.45%, XLU Utilities +2.44%, XLE Energy +1.92%.
Top industries: SILJ +16.95% and GDX +15.76% (precious metals); bottom: USO -1.33% and UNG -6.82%. Money went into XLF (+$1,174mm, 96th pct), XLK (+$708mm) and XLP; it left XLV (-$1,480mm, 0p) and XLE (-$1,179mm). Breadth was strong — 407/502 advancers, up/down volume 9.12, zero new 60-day lows. Label: broadening participation.

DRIVERS — Semis and silver led the squeeze, SOXX +8.65% and SLV +6.57%, with MU +7.60% Friday; energy was the only sector that failed to clear 2%, XLE +1.92% and USO -1.33%. Wednesday's data ran hot: Core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2% forecast, Real GDP revised to 4.3% vs 3.5%, durables soft at 0.2% — yet the tape still bid risk. Volume was light throughout (0.60x on indices), so treat the breadth as enthusiasm within a holiday-thinned tape. VIX at 26.8 versus VIXEQ at 47.9 says index vol is calmer than single-stock vol — dispersion, not index panic.

WHAT'S NEXT — Watch whether SPY reclaims its 200-day MA on real volume; the light 0.60x confirms little conviction behind the rally. QQQ ATM IV at 29% with max pain 635 versus spot near the GEX flip at 646 is the level to watch. Momentum (z -1.88) and quality (z -1.98, 149 days) remain in BEAR regime — a high-to-low roll is the risk if the rebound fades. Data: ISM Manufacturing 55 forecast Dec 1, ADP Dec 2, and the Dec 9 FOMC with rate-path odds unresolved.
